svg.title: FootyLevels Development deployment and trust boundaries
svg.desc: ngrok exposes only the authenticated loopback API. CPU workers hold cloud access; the private GPU runtime uses a user-only Unix socket. Demo has isolated cloud resources but no active API runtime.
